name: web
rules:
webhooks:
  - name: sink
    url: ${WEBHOOK_URL}/web
    template: '{"text": {{ json .Text }}}'

rules:
  - name: http-5xx
    files: ["/var/log/demo/web.log"]
    pattern: '" (?P<status>5\d\d) '
    severity: warning
    webhooks: [sink]
    suppress: {window: 1m, group_by: status}
